definitions.explanation: A body temperature that is slightly elevated above normal but not high enough to be considered a full fever. In Japan, generally refers to a temperature between 37.0°C and 37.9°C.

examples.english: I've had a slight fever since this morning.

examples.japanese: {微熱|びねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to the hospital because a low-grade fever has been persisting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひきはじめ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{微熱|びねつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{倦怠感|けんたいかん}→倦怠感：05023_kentaikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a slight fever and fatigue from the onset of a cold.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japanese medical contexts, fever levels are categorized as: {微熱|びねつ} (slight fever, ~37.0-37.9°C), {中等度|ちゅうとうど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (moderate fever, ~38.0-38.9°C), and ⟦{高熱|こうねつ}→高熱：14649_kounetsu⟧ (high fever, 39.0°C and above). {微熱|びねつ} is often used when describing early symptoms of illness or lingering low-grade fevers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {微熱|びねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a slight fever
- {微熱|びねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: a slight fever persists
- {微熱|びねつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がらない→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: the low-grade fever won't go down
